intent: Close the DharmaGraph-owned consumer and dispatch-custody halves of SADHANA crash recovery on top of Runtime V4 and the organism-owned Board effect provider. Before any provider effect, the orchestrator must persist the complete returned ExecutionIdentity into the exact TaskBoard assignment CAS and authenticated campaigns must use the Runtime Truth Spine. Terminal runtime claim/run/receipt truth must prepare one immutable same-runtime-store projection outbox; TaskBoard must re-derive that durable authority while holding its writer fence, commit the exact Board mutation and immutable before/after effect receipt in one Board transaction, and DharmaGraph must import that receipt as an exact witness before acknowledgement. Replay must close every interrupted prefix even if a later legitimate attempt advances the Board. Legacy non-campaign settlement receives the same Board-local exact-effect receipt pattern. Boot and periodic recovery must discover Board-only campaign custody, preserve effect-indeterminate attempts without minting retry authority, verify heartbeat identity under Board-to-runtime writer fencing, and gate stale/orphan recovery, rescue, generation, and dispatch on a fresh successful graph census. Exact generic and campaign dispatch custody must survive assignment, cancellation, shutdown, and BSP straggler settlement; recovery remains visible until Board settlement precedes exact release. A separately owned organism companion packet must bind Mission Control terminal observations to this durable projection authority after this commit. Runtime SQLite and TaskBoard SQLite remain explicitly separate transactions; convergence is receipt-backed and idempotent, never described as cross-database atomic. This packet performs no provider, transport, VPS, public route, or other external effect.

commit.message: fix(graph): close crash replay and dispatch custody

runtime_provides: generic campaign mutation fences and exact terminal TaskBoard CAS
complete new-claim ExecutionIdentity metadata and monotone runtime rows
canonical retry lineage and immutable runtime authority snapshots
sealed ProjectionIntent authority that distinguishes outcome evidence from scheduling choice
this_packet_provides: exact Board assignment persistence of complete ExecutionIdentity before effects
mandatory Runtime Truth Spine dispatch for authenticated campaigns
receipt-bound terminal outbox replay through an atomic Board-local before/after effect commit and exact imported witness before ACK
durable replay for both governed campaign projections and legacy non-campaign Board settlement
Board-only and runtime-only effect-indeterminate campaign crash holds without retry authority
Board-to-runtime fenced heartbeat and identity-registry proof
fresh graph-census readiness gates for boot and periodic recovery
assignment and recovery tasks retained in the shutdown census
exact generic TaskDispatch handoff release after bounded runner self-clear
BSP straggler settlement only after task cessation and exact custody release
cross_packet_interface.shared_proof: No campaign provider effect can begin before the exact Board row carries the complete runtime identity; process loss cannot remint attempt authority; a later bound terminal receipt can converge runtime and Board truth through replayable exact CAS.

interface_mismatches: The orchestrator currently copies claim metadata before RuntimeLifecycle constructs the new complete ExecutionIdentity, then overwrites the enriched task with that stale copy before the exact Board assignment CAS.
RuntimeLifecycle and RuntimeStateStore currently import missing Graph projection functions, so the sealed runtime packet is intentionally not deployable without this consumer.
The current Graph settlement calls generic Board requeue, complete, and fail methods instead of the exact receipt-backed terminal projection CAS.
The current boot reconciler treats in-flight campaign work without a receipt as safely requeueable or quarantinable rather than effect-indeterminate.
The current census cannot discover campaign custody committed to TaskBoard before its runtime claim/run is created.
The current projection acknowledgement can be inferred from a marker without an immutable exact target/readback witness.
Mission Control accepts a self-consistent pending ProjectionIntent without re-deriving its runtime authority.
Current stale/orphan recovery and dispatch are not all gated on a fresh successful Graph census.
Assignment and recovery tasks are not all retained in the graceful-stop census.
BSP can remove owner maps before proving task cessation and exact reservation release.
honest_blockers: This Graph commit remains fail-closed for campaign deployment until the separately owned organism companion binds Mission Control terminal observations and exact topology admission to the durable projection protocol.
An in-flight provider effect without a bound terminal receipt remains effect-indeterminate; this packet must not infer cessation or authorize a retry.
Runtime SQLite and TaskBoard SQLite are separate stores, so terminal convergence is exact and replayable but not cross-database atomic.

This packet proves local consumer mechanics only; it does not prove provider authenticity, useful output, deployment readiness, VPS byte identity, mobile authentication, rollback, or campaign completion.
Campaign dispatch remains stopped until this packet passes independent review, canonical CI, explicit merge approval, and exact VPS cutover verification.
The existing mobile control page is bounded operations control, not an authenticated conversational interface to this reviewed coordinator.
No external service, VPS, provider, public route, or Git remote may be mutated by this packet.
session_entry.rollback: Keep campaign dispatch stopped, preserve runtime.db and tasks.db for forensic reconciliation, and revert this consumer commit before reactivating any scheduler. Runtime V4 remains a valid fail-closed foundation, but its missing Graph consumer hooks mean provider execution must stay disabled until an equivalent exact consumer is restored.
